local_review.fix_note: No safe correction was made. local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the full local PR diff, generated support files, test changes, index integrity, local gate evidence, and resolved old/new statistics. The change is scoped to io.netty:netty-common:5.0.0.Alpha2, uses only reachability-metadata.json, preserves the Alpha1 tests except for replacing the removed Striped64/LongAdder path, contains no Native Image skip or swallowed Error pattern, and passes the overall dynamic-access and metadata-count guardrails. However, the resources breakdown regresses by more than the allowed 20 percentage points, so the tree cannot be approved as-is.
